summary_ja: Agentic workload向けCPUを、Veraのloaded per-core性能重視とEPYCの高thread密度・高周波数SKUの役割分担として比較しました。高周波数対多coreの普遍的勝者は決めず、agent段階、同時実行数、memory帯域、V/f、GPU待ちを揃えた測定課題へ変換します。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update compares Vera's emphasis on loaded per-core performance with EPYC's role-specific use of dense-thread and high-frequency SKUs. It does not select a universal frequency-versus-core-count winner; instead it defines measurements aligned by agent stage, concurrency, memory bandwidth, voltage-frequency settings, and GPU wait time. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_en: Vera design prioritizing loaded per-core performance
items.timing_en: Initial systems and partner evaluations in 2026
items.statement_ja: NVIDIA Veraは88 Olympus core、最大1.2 TB/s LPDDR5X、3.4 TB/sのcore間帯域を組み合わせ、全core負荷時のper-core性能と予測可能なlatencyを重視します。NVIDIAはx86比最大1.8倍のsustained per-core性能を主張し、Perplexityのrepository cloneとtest実行workflowで約1.5倍、concurrent sandbox起動で最大1.9倍と報告しています。ただし比較CPU、compiler、OS、repository、test構成、電力、同時実行数、測定logは公開情報だけでは揃わず、独立再現できません。clock周波数も公表されていないため、性能差を周波数だけへ帰属できません。
items.statement_en: NVIDIA Vera combines 88 Olympus cores, up to 1.2 TB/s of LPDDR5X bandwidth, and 3.4 TB/s of core-to-core bandwidth, prioritizing per-core performance and predictable latency under full-core load. NVIDIA claims up to 1.8x sustained per-core performance over x86 and reports about 1.5x for a Perplexity repository-clone-and-test workflow and up to 1.9x for concurrent sandbox startup. The public material does not align comparison CPUs, compilers, operating systems, repositories, test configurations, power, concurrency, or measurement logs, so the results are not independently reproducible. Clock frequency is also undisclosed, so the difference cannot be attributed to frequency alone.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 科学AI agentではGPU性能に加え、tool実行、build/test、data処理、sandbox起動がcritical pathになるため、loaded per-core性能とmemory帯域を測定対象に加えるべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Scientific AI agents place tool execution, build/test, data processing, and sandbox startup on the critical path, so loaded per-core performance and memory bandwidth should be measured alongside GPU performance.
adoption_conditions_ja: 公開repositoryと固定containerで単一agent latency、同時agent throughput、p95/p99を測定する。
core数、周波数、memory帯域、power limit、V/f設定を固定・記録する。
GPU idle時間とend-to-end task成功率をCPU単体benchmarkと併記する。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure single-agent latency, concurrent-agent throughput, and p95/p99 using public repositories and fixed containers.
Fix and record cores, frequency, memory bandwidth, power limits, and voltage-frequency settings.
Report GPU idle time and end-to-end task success alongside CPU-only benchmarks.

items.name_ja: EPYCのthread密度と高周波数SKUの役割分担
items.name_en: Role separation between EPYC thread-density and high-frequency SKUs
items.statement_ja: AMDはagent workflowを、sandbox、GPU host、general-purpose処理へ分けています。第6世代EPYCは最大512 thread、16 channel・12.8 GT/s MRDIMM、PCIe 6を示し、sandboxではthread密度、GPU hostでは最大5 GHzの選択SKUによるper-core性能を重視します。AMDのagents/CPU-dollar指標はthread数と1,000-unit価格から推定したproxyであり、実agentのthroughput、latency、memory footprint、software overheadを測定した値ではありません。このportfolioは、高周波数か多coreかをCPU単位で一択にせず、agent段階と同時実行数に応じて選ぶ設計を示します。
items.statement_en: AMD separates agent workflows into sandbox, GPU-host, and general-purpose roles. Its 6th Generation EPYC portfolio lists up to 512 threads, 16-channel 12.8 GT/s MRDIMM support, and PCIe 6; it emphasizes thread density for sandboxes and per-core performance from selected SKUs boosting up to 5 GHz for GPU hosts. AMD's agents-per-CPU-dollar metric is a proxy estimated from thread counts and 1,000-unit pricing, not measured agent throughput, latency, memory footprint, or software overhead. The portfolio supports selecting frequency and core count by agent stage and concurrency rather than choosing one CPU-wide winner.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIのagent用partitionは、少数の高周波数host nodeと多数sandbox向け高密度nodeを同一SKUに固定せず、実traceから構成比を決める余地があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: An HPCI agent partition can size high-frequency host nodes and dense sandbox nodes from measured traces rather than forcing both roles onto one SKU.
adoption_conditions_ja: agent traceから逐次区間、並列sandbox数、working set、I/O、GPU待ちを抽出する。
同一socket powerで高周波数SKUと高core SKUのtask/s、tail latency、energy/taskを比較する。
MRDIMM、PCIe、NIC、GPU接続を含むnode全体の価格と保守条件を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Extract sequential intervals, sandbox concurrency, working sets, I/O, and GPU waits from agent traces.
Compare tasks per second, tail latency, and energy per task for high-frequency and high-core SKUs at matched socket power.
Confirm whole-node price and support conditions including MRDIMM, PCIe, NICs, and GPU attachment.
